notes:
Both papers independently checked. Titles matched supplied references in bibliographic metadata. Source follow-up: PDF5–6 rendered and inspected. Table2 is a known predictor mismatch; its F and p are not extracted for complexity. Text reports only an omnibus complexity MANOVA, not a univariate target outcome test. Recruitment N95 is not certified as analytic n. Appendix B PDF9 was also rendered: its sample-size row visually prints Study2 N92, contrasting with95 recruited in methods. This row is absent from canonical TXT; parent transcription/sample-role check required, and neither count is silently adopted as target-test analytic n.
